tools.name: wire.list
tools.description: List published Silicon News Wire articles (newest first). Read-only. Never returns drafts or moderation rows.

tools.name: wire.get
tools.description: Fetch one published Silicon News Wire article by slug as a fact package (headline, summary, body, canonical/.md/.json URLs).

tools.name: wire.search
tools.description: Case-insensitive search of published title, summary, and body (English and Chinese fields). Empty matches are an empty list, not an error.
